run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with a given calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy using ML-relaxed adslab and DFT-relaxed slab energies via adsorb_atoms
compute_full_adsorption_energy: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both adslab and bare surface with adsorb_atoms relax_surface flag
relax_adslab_and_save: relax an adslab system and save relaxed atoms as JSON using adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms enabled
review_adsorb_atoms: review the adsorb_atoms function to understand how it computes direct, hybrid, and full adsorption energies
